newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Sept weekly earnings rise 1.8 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Canada Sept weekly earnings rise 1.8 pct on year.

text.p: The preliminary estimate of average weekly earnings for Canadian workers in all industries except agriculture and fishing rose 1.8 percent in September from a year earlier to a seasonally adjusted C$585.90, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
From the month before, earnings fell 0.5 percent.

Seasonally adjusted payroll employment fell 0.4 percent in September to 10.85 million from a revised 10.89 million in August. The August change in employment was revised to a 0.2 percent decline from a 0.4 percent fall.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that average weekly earnings would rise by 2.6 percent, year on year, after August's 2.4 percent rise.
